prompts.name: estate
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium professional chartered accountancy website, original 3D object sprite sheet.
Create a 3072x1024 landscape canvas, EXACTLY 3:1. GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background.
Composition: three equal square columns, each containing exactly ONE separate isolated object centered at x=512,1536,2560, y=512. Each object entirely within its own column with generous clear transparent margin (at least 140px on each edge of each column). Objects should fill about 65% of each square and read well at 250px. There are no actual panels or dividers. No objects, lighting glow or shadows crossing column thirds. No ground plane or cast floor shadow.
Art direction: exceptionally beautiful high-end Octane / Cinema4D sculptural editorial product still life, photorealistic 3D, tactile matte chalk porcelain and brushed aluminium, deep midnight navy, restrained blue/teal accents. Softbox highlights, rounded machined edges, realistic materials, balanced three-quarter isometric viewpoints, elegant floating objects. Cohesive studio lighting from upper left.
No cartoon, icons, outline, wireframe, infographic, text, numbers, logos, watermarks.
Objects from left to right:
LEFT: elegant miniature architectural facade tower block in cream and navy, no ground. MIDDLE: single refined precast pale concrete block with two through-holes. RIGHT: terracotta orange and white refined traffic cone.
